brief:
Settlers attacked homes in the Palestinian village of Arabeh, south of Jenin, on Saturday evening, according to Shehab Wire. The assailants opened fire during the assault on civilian residences, according to reports from the area.

The attack occurred as tensions remain elevated in the northern West Bank, where settler violence against Palestinian communities has continued in recent months. Residents of Arabeh faced property damage and the threat of armed confrontation during the Saturday evening incident. No immediate reports detailed casualties or the extent of damage to the targeted homes.
